Title: Azure Site Recovery available in US DoD and new Azure Government regions

Body.Content:
Availability of Azure Site Recovery has expanded to cover all Azure Government regions in the United States. Site Recovery is now available in US DOD Central, US DOD East, US Gov Arizona, US Gov Texas, US Gov Iowa, and US Gov Virginia. Customers can select any of these regions to deploy Site Recovery with the same reliability and performance levels described in the Site Recovery SLA. 

To learn more about Azure Site Recovery, visit the Site Recovery page.
